decks.summary: Flexible Charlie who swings from primary clue getter to near-primary fighter by exhausting stat-boost allies, filling his board with Charisma, Calling in Favors and A Chance Encounter; best at three or four players.
S-Team Charlie led by Bonnie Walsh, Lonnie Ritter, Michael Leigh and Trigger Man, fighting with Enchanted Blade and Switchblade (2) and recruiting with Motivational Speech.
Expert multiplayer combat Charlie who fights with Meat Cleaver and Guard Dogs, takes clues through Summoned Hounds, and recurs allies with A Chance Encounter and Short Supply.
A joke deck of nearly fifty different allies brought in through Forced Learning; theme over function.
Flex Charlie who passes any test by exhausting allies, recruits with upgraded Motivational Speech, and kills through parley with Whispers of Doom doubled by Eldritch Tongue.
Drawn to the Flame podcast Charlie who smashes one test a turn by exhausting allies for Quick Thinking and Lucky Cigarette Case payoffs, taking clues with Old Keyrings and "Look what I found!".
True solo Carcosa Charlie who gets allies out fast with Motivational Speech and Calling in Favors, funded by Lone Wolf and Easy Mark, and fights with Runic Axe and Machete.
Pure-cluever Charlie who mills allies with Short Supply and replays them with A Chance Encounter, succeeds by 2 for Scavenging and Newspapers, and buys clues with Lola Santiago.
Detective Charlie with Milan, Abigail Foreman and Summoned Hounds boosting his investigations, Practice Makes Perfect and At a Crossroads for draw, and The Raven Quill for clues.
Combo Charlie who finds Bonnie Walsh, Summoned Hounds and Miss Doyle fast to reach huge skill values on any test, recycling allies with A Chance Encounter and Calling in Favors.
